facts.text: Load the beer, grab the burgers and let's roll. Bandit's already halfway to Texarkana.
facts.why: Not a Snowman line. The Bandit is blocking in the Trans Am and the pair only reach Texarkana at the start of the run. His real line about Fred is on Wikiquote.
